translations.web: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
translations.bsb: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
translations.kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
